## Examples

```esql
FROM employees
| EVAL decay_result = decay(salary, 0, 100000, {"offset": 5, "decay": 0.5, "type": "linear"})
| SORT decay_result DESC
```

| decay_result:double |
| --- |
| 0.873405 |
| 0.8703 |
| 0.870145 |
| 0.867845 |
| 0.86395 |

Boost the relevance score of recent books, giving books without a year half the score:

```esql
FROM books METADATA _score
| WHERE MATCH(author, "Faulkner")
| EVAL boosted = _score * COALESCE(DECAY(year, 2005, 1, {"type": "exp", "decay": 0.25}), 0.5)
| SORT boosted DESC
| KEEP book_no, author, year
| LIMIT 2
```

| book_no:keyword | author:text | year:integer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2883 | William Faulkner | 2005 |
| 3293 | Danny Faulkner | 2004 |
